title: Viva Insights: Copilot Analytics Agent Dashboard for agent adoption and Copilot Credit usage
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap, the supplied tenant notice and current Microsoft Learn documentation, including the recently changed licensing table. Two admin routes need minor completion; neither sends administrators to the wrong setting. The conflicting rollout dates and licensing prerequisites are already disclosed.

claims.quote: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents.

claims.where: Scope: Who and where; Open questions
claims.claim: Agent Dashboard is not currently available in national or regional clouds, including U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard isn't currently available for national/regional cloud deployments including but not limited to Microsoft's U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.

claims.claim: Agent Dashboard policies are reached in Microsoft 365 admin center through Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Agent Dashboard > Add policy.
claims.quote: Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. ... On the Feature access management page, select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.
claims.fix: Include the intervening page heading: Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Feature access management > Agent Dashboard > Add policy. The omitted heading requires no additional selection.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AgentDashboard -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights FeatureId : AgentDashboard Name : DisableFeatureForAll IsFeatureEnabled : false Everyone

claims.claim: AI Administrators or Global Administrators can manage Agent Dashboard access.
claims.quote: | Insights | Agent Dashboard | No | Global admin or AI admin | Viva Insights |

claims.where: controls[0].scope; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Agent Dashboard VFAM policies can enable or disable access at tenant, group or user level.
claims.quote: The AI admin can enable or disable the Agent Dashboard at the tenant, group, or user level using the Agent Dashboard VFAM control in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Web-app access assignments are managed in Microsoft 365 admin center under Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. ... At the bottom, select Add.
claims.fix: For adding access, complete the route as Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users or Groups > user or group > Add. For removal, append Users or Groups > existing user or group > Remove selected users or Remove selected groups to the existing route. It currently stops on the correct access-management page.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling the web app.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights FeatureId : Viva Insights web app Name : DisableFeatureForAll IsFeatureEnabled : false Everyone

claims.claim: The second row's UI manages individual-user and group access assignments rather than creating the tenant-wide policy shown by its PowerShell call.
claims.quote: Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups ... To disable access for existing report users: ... Select Remove selected users or Remove selected groups.

claims.claim: Turning off the Viva Insights web app disables the entire app, including the Copilot Dashboard, rather than only Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: AI Administrators do not automatically receive Viva Insights web app access.
claims.quote: The AI Administrator does not have automatic access to the Viva Insights web app. To gain access, the admin must also add themselves using the process below.

claims.claim: Both the Viva Insights web app control and Agent Dashboard control must be enabled to access Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: To access the Agent Dashboard, both the Viva Insights web app control and this control must be enabled.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Both printed PowerShell calls use the documented Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy operation and parameters to create feature access policies.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -FeatureId <String> -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean> -ModuleId <String> -Name <String> ... [-Everyone]

claims.claim: Up to 10 access policies can be assigned per feature.
claims.quote: You can assign up to 10 policies per feature.

claims.claim: One additional policy per feature can be assigned to the entire tenant.
claims.quote: An additional one policy per feature can be assigned to the entire tenant.

claims.claim: User or group policies take precedence over a tenant-wide policy.
claims.quote: Policies assigned to a specific user or group take priority over the policy assigned to the entire tenant when determining whether a feature is enabled.

claims.claim: Where multiple user or group policies apply to one user, the most restrictive applies.
claims.quote: If a user has multiple policies assigned for a feature (directly as a user or member of a group), the most restrictive policy applies.

claims.claim: The cmdlet requires Global Administrators membership or a role assigned at feature level.
claims.quote: Currently, you need to be a member of the Global Administrators role or the roles that have been assigned at the feature level to run this cmdlet.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can manage all settings described on the dashboard settings page.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: The settings page allows AI Administrators to manage Viva Insights web app access.
claims.quote: Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups ... Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: The general VFAM feature table lists Global admin as the manager of the Viva Insights web app control.
claims.quote: | | Viva Insights web app | No | Global admin | Viva Insights |

claims.claim: Dashboard auto-enablement can be controlled using the VFAM FeatureId AutoCxoIdentification.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off dashboard auto-enablement for your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights FeatureId : AutoCxoIdentification Name : DisableFeatureForAll IsFeatureEnabled : false Everyone

claims.claim: The dashboard auto-enablement control supports tenant-level policies only.
claims.quote: This control supports tenant-level policies only, not user or group-level policies.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls: Other settings
claims.claim: A unified exclusion list can hide employees' data from Agent Dashboard aggregates.
claims.quote: Your organization might want to exclude certain users from being included in the aggregated insights in the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Agent Dashboard, Consumption Dashboard, or Viva Insights

claims.claim: The exclusion-list policy must be turned on for the exclusion list to work.
claims.quote: To use an exclusion list, you must turn on the policy.

claims.claim: Absent an exclusion list, employees with a Copilot license, Viva Insights license or manual cohort upload are included in dashboard insights.
claims.quote: If you don't create an exclusion list, all employees who either have a Copilot license, a Viva Insights license, or are uploaded manually using the Cohort upload feature in the admin center, are included in dashboard insights and Viva Insights collaboration behavior reports.

claims.claim: The default minimum group size is 10 employees.
claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set, which by default is 10 employees.

claims.claim: The configurable minimum group size must be at least five.
claims.quote: Enter your preferred minimum group size, which must be at least five, then select Save.

claims.claim: The documented minimum-group-size route is Settings > Microsoft Viva > Microsoft Viva Insights > Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365 > Manage minimum group size.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 Admin Center ... Settings ... Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights. ... Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.claim: The printed admin-center minimum-group-size route applies to tenants without a Viva Insights license.
claims.quote: If your tenant does not have a Viva Insights license, use these steps to set the minimum group size

claims.claim: The separate Agent 365 reporting-visibility VFAM control has FeatureId Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility.
claims.quote: Example: Exclude non-public agents from Agent 365 Dashboard view reporting ... ModuleId : VivaInsights FeatureId : Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility IsFeatureEnabled : false

claims.claim: That reporting-visibility control can limit the Agent 365 Dashboard view to public agents.
claims.quote: You can also use VFAM to set whether reporting in the Agent 365 Dashboard view includes non-public agents, or only agents available to all users in the organization.
